title: ErasureScopeSealed
description:
`erasure_scope_sealed` — the closing survey sealed an erasure's scope. A container erasure
cannot complete before it. Carries the count and the digest of the late members so far.

late_count.description: How many members arrived after the declaration.

late_digest.description: The digest of the late members, taken over their `erasure_member_arrived` records.
